name: best-of-n
description: Sample N candidate answers to one prompt in parallel (each at a different temperature), judge them against stated criteria, and select the winner — the engine-native half of the best-of-n skill, calling the same sampling core so template and skill cannot drift.

prompt.help: The prompt every candidate answers — identical for all N. The variation is the sampling temperature, not the ask.

n.help: How many candidates to sample (1-5; the core clamps a larger ask to 5). Each candidate is a separate metered model call, so N is the cost multiplier.

criteria.help: What 'best' means for this ask — the judge scores every candidate against this. Blank falls back to the core's generic bar (an unstated bar is still a bar, just a weaker one).

metadata.why_metered: One run costs N sampling calls plus one judge pass per surviving candidate. Every call rides the ModelCallGuard chokepoint, so the multiplier is visible in model_calls.jsonl and bounded by the SpendMeter — and the core caps N at 5 so a template cannot quietly buy 20x spend.

steering_examples.description: Sample 5 instead of 3, and judge on brevity above everything else.
Change the criteria to 'no marketing language, concrete numbers only' before the sample node runs.

example_outputs: the winning candidate's text, with the full slate (candidates + judgments + scores) in the sample node's output for 'use #2 instead'
metadata.when_not_to_use: anything with one correct answer — N samples of a lookup is N times the cost for the same answer; and never inside a foreach, which multiplies the spend per item

children.label: Fan out N samples, judge, select
